production.note: US model years of the sedan. First: MBUSA's '2015 Mercedes-AMG C63 S/C63 Sedan Quick Reference Guide' ('March 2015 U.S. dealer launch'); MBUSA also published 2015, 2017 and 2019 sedan specification sheets (mbusa-2015-c-class-sedan-specs, mbusa-2017-c63-sedan-specs, mbusa-2019-c63-sedan-specs). Last: Cars.com lists an 'AMG C 63 S Sedan' trim for 2021 (carscom-2021-c63) but for 2022 shows only the 'AMG C 63 S Cabriolet' (carscom-2022-c63). The C 63 S Coupe (C205) is a separate record (mercedes-amg-c-63-s-coupe-c205); the Cabriolet (A205) is not in the game.

displacementL.note: 3,982 cc ('Displacement (cc) | 3,982'); the 2015 and 2019 sheets give the same figure.

fuel.note: Inferred from the sheet's description of the V8 biturbo petrol engine.

drivetrain.note: 'Drive Configuration | Rear-wheel drive'; the 2019 sheet: 'Rear-Wheel drive'.

transmission.note: 2015-2018: 'AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 7-Speed Sport Transmission' (2017 sheet: 'AMG 7-Speed SPEEDSHIFT® MCT'). 2019-2021: 'AMG SPEEDSHIFT® MCT 9-Speed' (mbusa-2019-c63-sedan-specs). MCT is a planetary automatic with a wet start-up clutch in place of the torque converter.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower @rpm | ... | C63: 469 hp at 5500 rpm / C63 S: 503 hp at 5500 rpm". Quick reference guide (mbusa-2015-c63-qrg): "503 hp @ 5,500 – 6,250 rpm". The 2017 and 2019 sheets give the same "503 @ 5,500 – 6,250" (mbusa-2017-c63-sedan-specs, mbusa-2019-c63-sedan-specs). The non-S C 63 (469 hp) is a separate variant.

weightLb.note: US curb weight, sedan with the only transmission (7-speed MCT), 2015 sheet. Quote: "Curb weight (lbs.) | 3,417 lbs. | 3,594 lbs. | 4,012 lbs. | 3,693 lbs. | C63: 3,924 lbs./ C63 S: 3,935 lbs.". The 2017 sheet gives the same: "C63 S: 3,935" (mbusa-2017-c63-sedan-specs). The 2019 (facelift) sheet reads "TBA". The 2015 sheet also lists a plug-in hybrid C-Class column, which suggests MBUSA updated the page after first publication; its C63 S figure matches the 2017 sheet.

reviewNotes: The last sedan model year (2021) rests on Cars.com trim listings; no MBUSA page for the 2020 or 2021 C 63 S Sedan was opened. Body decision (3 October 2026, owner): the Sedan and the Coupe are separate cars in the game; the Cabriolet is not included.
